aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs, and maintain strict stop discipline as losses can accumulate rapidly.
